verdict.seen: A narrow black shaft cut into the ground cross-section, reaching down to the blue water table, with a small patch of water at the bottom.
Close-up of dirt walls beside a dark shaft with a CAVE-IN label, but no soil falling or collapsing across frames.
verdict.problem: Show wall soil breaking away and chunks tumbling down the shaft; the walls and shaft look identical across frames.

verdict.seen: A flat brown box fills the shaft, with no visible water beneath it and no sign of depth. It looks like a plain block.
verdict.problem: Show wet mud rising in the shaft over the water, with texture and a visible level change; the block looks like a pasted box.

verdict.seen: A weight gauge beside the mud counts from 0 to 3,000 and the bar turns red.
The mud-filled shaft with a 3,000 gauge in the first frame, then a grey steel casing standing in the shaft down to the water.
The casing is traced by glowing yellow outline lines down both sides, in the shaft down to the water.
Close view of the casing bottom in water with an outline in frame one; the water level does not visibly drop and the view stays at the bottom.
verdict.problem: Show the water level dropping far down relative to the casing and ground; the water just stays around the casing bottom.

verdict.seen: A grey pump grows at the bottom of the casing in the water and a thin pipe rises from its top.
The pump is surrounded by a glowing outline, with the pipe on top, underwater.
Blue water dots run up the thin pipe with white up arrows, from the pump at the bottom toward the surface.
Down arrows beside the casing, dark dirt particles and DIRTY WATER label, and the water turning murky.
Brown clay strips grow down on both sides of the casing, while the water dots keep rising up the pipe.
A blue pressure tank pops up on the lawn beside the house with a pipe connecting to it.
Underground close-up of the casing and clay with rising water dots; no steel cap, grass cap or bushes appear.
verdict.problem: Show the surface with the steel cap, grass cap and bushes placed around the well, not the underground pipe.

verdict.seen: The camera pulls back to the finished build: house, bushes, pressure tank, well with clay, pipe and pump above the water, all in view.
